name: Uno-X
verdict: Uno-X is Reitan Retail's fuel and EV-charging brand, and the team it sponsors is owned by the group; the whole Reitan group belongs to the Reitan family. Nothing found.
note: Title sponsor of Uno-X Mobility (men's team) and Uno-X Mobility Women; the team is owned and operated by Uno-X Mobility (Reitan Retail). Rating note: owner chain sourced (Reitan Retail → REITAN AS → Reitan family, Odd Reitan and sons). No state or fund stake; no human-rights record found against the group (searched ILO/NGO/press). Rated none.
